registration.external_submission: Requires explicit user decision; no OSF filing or registration priority is claimed
registration.amendments: Version and hash every change; list exposure and reason before new outcomes or model comparisons

models.cutoff_reason: No exact training cutoff verified. Immutable official weights uploaded before origin provide the chronology route.
models.runtime_validation: pending Task 4; no hardware capacity claim from file size alone

development.cases: Existing ten case pack; all exposed, development-only; repeat action/modality variants remain dependent
development.sources: Sealed contemporary OT25.09/HGNC2026 packets; contextual annotations, not intervention validation
development.primary_measure: Source-linked claim precision/error and evidence selection; no clinical discrimination claim
development.human_review: Independent blinded reference panel still required for H5; model review is development feedback only

clinical.window_justification: Selected for user-supplied paired archive availability and immutable September 2024 weights; not selected using clinical performance. UTC values are analytic calendar boundaries, not verified archive public times.
clinical.archive_precision: Dump creation time and ZIP time do not establish first-public availability. Unknown timezone and end-of-window reporting lag require qualification before activation.
clinical.origin_selection: Enumerate only origin experimental interventional Phase1/2 drug programs with full arm, regimen, population and prior-risk audit. Resolve drugs/targets/conditions with eligible historical versions only. Seal cohort IDs, eligibility reasons and dependency groups before endpoint query. Exclude every previously inspected program/NCT from a confirmatory candidate or call the entire analysis retrospective development.
endpoint_hierarchy: Tier1 registry recorded next-phase actual start, adjudicated program/regimen/population and role linkage; enrollment surrogate, not success
Tier2 protocol status/design change is separate
Tier3 results or success require explicit independent adjudication; no automatic clinical-success labels
clinical.missing_outcomes: No recorded transition is not a negative. Record latest observation, reporting delay, censoring and unresolved status. No binary Brier/AUC until negatives/censoring qualify.

predictor_sources.normalization: Identifiers and annotations from this release only; current HGNC/MONDO/OT cannot fill gaps

clinical.outcome_access: AACT endpoint and previously reviewed outcome links remain evaluator-only. No network tools, raw paths, search engine or later model is exposed to historical agents. Current coding agent must not add later scientific knowledge to packets.
clinical.power_rule: Repeat frozen v0.2 conditional power on qualified new-window dependence units, with >=80% power for 0.05 AUC difference under justified assumptions. Otherwise report feasibility/descriptive results; no powered superiority claim.
clinical.analysis: Preserve original H1-H6 meanings. AUROC/Brier co-primary only with qualified binary outcomes and calibrated scores; paired component bootstrap intervals and all exclusions/missingness; paired DeLong sensitivity when independence is defensible. Freeze multiplicity plan and scores before any confirmatory label join. H3 bottom publication tercile uses origin-dated counts; H4 requires validated genetics; H5 independent blinded panel; H6 separate gated protocol.

comparison.label: Adapted local-model, evidence-constrained Virtual Biotech comparison; not original reproduction
comparison.rules: Same origin-filtered source world, selected data, budgets and case pack. Record deviations and unsupported upstream datasets; do not fabricate replacements. No comparator performance until its adapter and semantic output pass validation.
baselines: origin-masked OT association descriptive metric, if eligible
ablations: no scorer, only if scorer qualifies
no causal genetics, only if derivations qualify

stopping_rules: No paid provider calls, new account, paid transfer or public submission
Stop locked clinical execution on any chronology/lineage/canary failure
No automatic retry of unknown-dispatch calls; preserve failures
Stop confirmatory inference if independent truth or power gate fails
Do not promote exploratory T6 error or relevance judgments to independent validation
